# Popover

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

overlays · tier 1 · beta · runs in the browser.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

For a small panel beside the control that opens it: a few lines, a link, a field, an action.
A tooltip is plain text. Anything with a link or a control is a Popover.

```ts
import {
  PopoverClose, PopoverDescription, PopoverPopup, PopoverRoot, PopoverTitle, PopoverTrigger,
} from 'topclassui'
```

```tsx
<PopoverRoot>
  <PopoverTrigger render={<Button variant="outline">Share</Button>} />
  <PopoverPopup>
    <PopoverTitle>Share this page</PopoverTitle>
    <PopoverDescription>Anyone with the link can read it. Only your team can edit.</PopoverDescription>
    <Button size="sm" className="self-start">Copy link</Button>
  </PopoverPopup>
</PopoverRoot>
```

- **Parts.** Six flat names and no bare `Popover`: `PopoverRoot`, `PopoverTrigger`,
  `PopoverPopup`, `PopoverTitle`, `PopoverDescription` and `PopoverClose`. Each part passes
  the rest of its props to the element it draws. `PopoverRoot` draws none.
- **Placement.** `placement` on `PopoverPopup`: twelve values, `bottom` by default. `start`
  and `end` are the reading sides, so they swap in Arabic. Never `left` or `right`.
- **At an edge.** It opens on the other side when its own has no room. When neither above
  nor below fits, it moves beside the trigger. It stays 8 px inside the screen.
- **Scrolling.** The popup is 280 px wide and never taller than the room it has. Past that
  it scrolls inside itself, and the page does not move with it.
- **A long text.** While the popup scrolls it is a tab stop, so the keyboard reaches a text
  with no control in it. You write no `tabIndex`; `tabIndex={-1}` opts out.
- **Width.** One width. For another, pass a class: `className="w-96"`.
- **Labels.** Two forms work, on `PopoverTrigger` and on `PopoverClose`:
  `render={<Button>Share</Button>}`, and `render={<Button />}` with `Share` as children.
  On a server page only the first keeps the ellipsis of a long label, so the demos use it.
- **A name.** `PopoverTitle` is the name of the popover and `PopoverDescription` its
  description, which is what a screen reader is given when it opens. Put the text there.
  With no title, pass `aria-label` to `PopoverPopup`.
- **First focus.** It lands on the first control. With no control inside, on the popup.
  After a tap it lands on the popup, so no keyboard slides up. A form puts `autoFocus` on
  its field.
- **Tab.** Tab past the last control closes it and goes on down the page. Shift+Tab goes
  back to the trigger.
- **Closing.** Escape, a press outside, or a `PopoverClose`. Focus returns to the trigger.
- **Escape.** It closes one thing: a tooltip open inside the popover first, then the
  popover, then the dialog around it.
- **The page behind.** It stays in use: it scrolls, takes presses and is read. The popup
  follows its trigger, and hides when the trigger scrolls out of view.
- **A form.** Put the `form` inside `PopoverPopup`. Do not write `render={<form />}` on it:
  that puts `role="dialog"` on a `form`, which HTML does not allow.
  Give the form an `action` or an `onSubmit`: with neither, the browser sends it and
  reloads the page. To close the popover on save, hold `open` in a client file.
- **A long action.** A label wider than the popup ends in an ellipsis, as on any Button.
- **A wide element.** A `pre` or a table wider than the popup makes the popup scroll
  sideways. Give it its own `overflow-x-auto` instead.
- **Arabic inside an English page.** The popup takes its direction and its language from
  the nearest `TopClassProvider`. With no provider it takes those of the page.

### The x

A `PopoverClose` with nothing in it is the x. You place it. In a row with the title, the
title wraps beside it:

```tsx
<PopoverRoot>
  <PopoverTrigger render={<Button variant="outline">Notifications</Button>} />
  <PopoverPopup>
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
      <PopoverTitle>Notifications are paused</PopoverTitle>
      <PopoverClose />
    </div>
    <PopoverDescription>You will get one summary tomorrow at nine instead.</PopoverDescription>
  </PopoverPopup>
</PopoverRoot>
```

- **A text close.** `<PopoverClose render={<Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>} />`.
- **When to add one.** A touch screen reader has no Escape key. Give a popover with more
  than a line of text an x or a text close.

### Opening on hover

```tsx
<PopoverRoot>
  <PopoverTrigger openOnHover delay={100} closeDelay={200} render={<Button variant="ghost">Billing details</Button>} />
  <PopoverPopup placement="bottom-start">
    <PopoverTitle>How billing works</PopoverTitle>
    <PopoverDescription>Only the seats in use are billed.</PopoverDescription>
  </PopoverPopup>
</PopoverRoot>
```

- **`openOnHover`.** The pointer opens it too. A press and the keyboard still do.
- **`delay`, `closeDelay`.** Milliseconds, 0 to 10000. Left out: 300 and 0. Give
  `closeDelay` 200 or so when the popover holds a link, so the pointer can reach it.
- **Focus.** A popover the pointer opened does not take the focus.

### What Base UI gives

| Prop | On | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange` | `PopoverRoot` | Open state, yours or its own. |
| `modal` | `PopoverRoot` | How much of the page it blocks. See below. |
| `openOnHover` | `PopoverTrigger` | The pointer opens it too. |
| `initialFocus`, `finalFocus` | `PopoverPopup` | Where focus goes on open and on close. |
| `container`, `keepMounted` | `PopoverPopup` | Where it mounts, and whether it stays mounted while closed. |
| `nativeButton` | `PopoverTrigger`, `PopoverClose` | `false` when `render` is not a button. |

- **`modal={false}` (the default).** The page scrolls, takes presses and is read. Tab past
  the last control closes the popover.
- **`modal="trap-focus"`.** The page scrolls and takes presses. Tab stays in the popover and
  the page is hidden from a screen reader, but only with a `PopoverClose` inside.
- **`modal`.** The page does not scroll and takes no press: a press outside only closes the
  popover. No scrim is drawn. Tab stays in and the page is hidden from a screen reader, but
  only with a `PopoverClose` inside.
- **`modal` on a phone.** A tap outside still only closes it, but the page scrolls.
- **Without a `PopoverClose`.** Base UI holds the focus of no popover that has none: Tab
  leaves it, and a screen reader reads on.
- **From a server page.** Pass text, numbers, booleans and elements (`render={<Button />}`).
  Pass no function: `onOpenChange`, a function `render`, a function `initialFocus` or
  `finalFocus`, and `actionsRef` need a `'use client'` file.

### Not built

The arrow, `size` (one width: pass a class), `sideOffset` as a prop, a `dismissible` prop,
a scrim, and a trigger outside its `PopoverRoot` (Base UI's `handle`: hold `open` in a
client file instead).

## Import

```tsx
import {
  PopoverRoot,
  PopoverClose,
  PopoverDescription,
  PopoverPopup,
  PopoverTitle,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from 'topclassui'
```

## Props

Every prop below is optional and falls back to the default shown.

### PopoverRoot

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | no | `ReactNode` | - | The trigger and the popup. With no trigger, hold `open` in a client file. |

### PopoverClose

This part takes no design props of its own.

### PopoverDescription

This part takes no design props of its own.

### PopoverPopup

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `placement` | no | `top` \| `top-start` \| `top-end` \| `bottom` \| `bottom-start` \| `bottom-end` \| `start` \| `start-top` \| `start-bottom` \| `end` \| `end-top` \| `end-bottom` | `"bottom"` | PopoverPopup: the side and alignment it opens at; start and end mirror in Arabic. |

### PopoverTitle

This part takes no design props of its own.

### PopoverTrigger

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `closeDelay` | no | `number`, min 0, max 10000 | `0` | PopoverTrigger, with openOnHover: milliseconds it stays open after the pointer leaves, clamped. |
| `delay` | no | `number`, min 0, max 10000 | `300` | PopoverTrigger, with openOnHover: milliseconds of hover before it opens, clamped. |

`PopoverRoot` draws no element, so it takes no `className`, `style` or `ref`. Anything else on another part is passed to the element it draws, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
